subject: CareBridge privacy summary and PII scope check
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@carebridge.health>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@carebridge.health>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap — data handling / PII confirmation items

Hi Olivia / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and a short list of concrete confirmations you asked for around PII and prompt/output handling so you can take to your security review: 

Summary of what we discussed (short):
- Use case: CareBridge will call Redwood hosted API for triage assistant prompts and occasional patient-summary generation. Some prompts will include limited PHI (name, DOB, short notes).
- Concern: what parts of request/response are stored, where they are stored (region), and default retention windows. Also need to understand audit/logging and any available redaction controls.

Please see answers/next steps below — we want to ensure these match your requirements before we draft the DPA addendum language.

What Redwood stores by default (hosted API):
- Input prompts: stored for up to 30 days for abuse monitoring and model quality work.
- Model outputs/completions: stored for up to 30 days.
- Request metadata (timestamps, client IPs in aggregated form, model id): retained for 90 days.
- Audit logs (api keys used, access records): retained for 90 days by default, with enterprise retention add-ons available.

Residency and deployment options:
- Hosted: US regions by default. EU-only residency can be provided on Dedicated (reserved capacity) or Private (VPC) deployments; for hosted we can route workload to US-east.
- Dedicated / Private: retention and region are configurable; data can be pinned to a customer region and retention set to your policy via contract.

Controls and mitigations available today:
- No-persist flag: for Dedicated & Private, customers can opt out of persistent logging of prompt/output (no_persist) — hosted customers can request opt-out via contract with additional review.
- Redaction SDK: on the client side you can run token-level redaction before sending. We also offer prompt templates and prompt scrubbing helpers in our SDKs.
- Access control: role-based access, audit trails, and optional KMS integration for Private deployments.

Attachments: attached a short data-flow diagram to show telemetry vs. persisted data ([Attachment: redwood-psm-data-flow.pdf (PDF, 320 KB)]).

Requested follow-ups (action items):
1) Olivia / security: confirm whether 30-day rolling retention for prompts/outputs is acceptable, or whether you need immediate non-persistence for all PHI-containing calls.
2) We will prepare draft DPA language for your review (we can fast-track DocuSign once you confirm residency/retention requirements).
3) If you need a Dedicated/Private deployment, let us know preferred region and expected qps so we can produce a capacity estimate.

If it helps, Karthik (cc'd) will provide a short, copy-ready paragraph you can paste into your vendor review that summarizes Redwood's default hosted behavior and Dedicated/Private options.

Thanks — happy to jump on another call if you want to walk this through with your security team.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: redwood-psm-data-flow.pdf]

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@carebridge.health>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@carebridge.health>, security@carebridge.health
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — data handling / PII confirmation items

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the clear recap and diagram — that helps. A few points to confirm from our side so we can complete the initial security screen: 

1) Retention windows:
- CareBridge policy requires that any vendor-stored PHI from production workflows be retained no longer than 30 days; we prefer non-persistence for PHI wherever possible.
- For non-PHI telemetry we are comfortable with 90-day retention for aggregated logs.

2) Residency:
- All PHI for CareBridge patients must remain in the US. We will not accept mixed EU residency for PHI data.

3) Redaction / non-persistence:
- We need confirmation that there is a supported option to ensure PHI-containing prompts and outputs are not persisted for hosted traffic. If hosted cannot guarantee this, we will evaluate Dedicated/Private.

4) Evidence:
- Please provide SOC 2 Type II report (or a link) and a copy of your DPA.
- Attached our security questionnaire — please return with answers to the spreadsheet tabs on data residency, retention, and encryption.

Next steps: if you can send the copy-ready summary and DPA draft, we will circulate internally. Also please indicate whether Redwood can enable non-persistence for a scoped set of API keys as a short-term mitigation.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Information Security | CareBridge Health
olivia.chen@carebridge.health

[Attachment: CBRG_Security_Questions.xlsx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@carebridge.health>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — data handling / PII confirmation items

Hi Olivia — copying Marissa (product/security liaison) and Stephanie. Below is a concise, copy-ready summary you can include in your risk assessment, plus specific confirmations for the items you flagged.

Copy-ready summary (paste into vendor review):
"Redwood Inference (hosted offering) retains customer request prompts and model outputs for up to 30 days by default for abuse monitoring and model quality. Request metadata and telemetry (aggregated access logs, model metrics) are retained for 90 days. For customers requiring different controls, Redwood offers Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) and Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments where retention, regional residency, and persistence can be configured contractually. A no-persist configuration is available for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted non-persistence for PHI may be enabled under negotiated contractual terms with additional review. Audit logs and API access records are included and can be exported for customers; enterprise retention add-ons extend storage beyond default windows. Data at rest is encrypted with customer-managed KMS options available on Private deployments."
Specific confirmations / answers: 
- Hosted default: prompts + outputs = 30 days; metadata/logs = 90 days.
- Non-persistence: 
  * Hosted: non-persistence (zero retention) for PHI is not a self-serve option today. We can enable scoped non-persistence for specific API keys under a contractual DPA amendment and operational runbook — this requires a short security onboarding.
  * Dedicated/Private: configurable — you can opt for no persistent storage for prompts/outputs.
- Residency: 
  * Hosted: US-only regions are available and we can route traffic to US-east to satisfy US-residency requirements for PHI.
  * If you require an isolated deployment, Dedicated (dedicated GPUs in a single region) or Private (VPC) is recommended.
- Audit logs & telemetry: retained 90 days by default; we can produce filtered audit exports and longer retention as an add-on.
- Encryption: data at rest encrypted, and Private supports customer KMS.

Evidence / docs we are attaching / linking:
- SOC 2 overview & contact link: https://redwood.example.com/soc2-report
- Draft DPA (attached): Redwood-DPA-2026.pdf
- DocuSign link for DPA when ready: https://app.docusign.com/Redwood-DPA-CB-2026

Action items for CareBridge (please confirm):
1) Confirm whether 30-day retention for prompts/outputs is acceptable for production PHI (yes/no). If no, indicate whether Dedicated or Private is preferred and desired region (US-west/us-east).
2) If you want hosted non-persistence for a scoped set of keys, indicate the API key labels and we will route to the security onboarding flow.

If helpful I can provide a short redaction sample (script snippet) that shows how you can remove PHI client-side before sending — Marissa can attach that.

Thanks — happy to set up an SSO/infra call next week if you prefer.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Security | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

[Attachment: Redwood-DPA-2026.pdf]

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@carebridge.health>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@carebridge.health>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:50:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — data handling / PII confirmation items

Karthik / Stephanie,

Appreciate the detailed summary and the DPA. A couple quick asks so we can move to procurement: 
- Please send the DocuSign DPA (we'll review legal).
- We will accept 30-day retention for prompts/outputs if you can enable scoped non-persistence for production PHI keys within the hosted offering during our onboarding window — please confirm the operational checklist and expected turnaround.
- Please provide the redaction SDK snippet Marissa referenced.

Happy to schedule a 30-minute call on Thursday to confirm next steps.

Thanks,
Olivia
Head of Information Security | CareBridge Health

[Next: schedule call; Procurement to review DPA]
